function.name: check_service_area
function.description: Check whether Summit Air services a ZIP code. Summit Air serves residential homes in Brooklyn, Queens and Staten Island only. Returns in_area, county, serviceable, and reason (residential_only or out_of_area) when not serviceable.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code of the service address, e.g. 11372.

property_type.description: Whether the property is a home (residential) or a business (commercial). Defaults to residential.
